probabilityModel.equalizer: Uniform every compatible eligible leaf including None, after hard guards. Suppress Human50% and Backstory factors.

contracts.scope: One main draw after Power; approved immediate Backstory extra uses same pool and saved return before Size.
contracts.none: No extra weakness, never clear previous Cursed/Rage/Overload/Backstory weaknesses.
contracts.duplicate: Same canonical definition merges distinct source provenance, never doubles penalties; independent actual draws may repeat.
contracts.conditional: Only an explicit active combat-condition guard applies a conditional restriction. Never subtract it from always-on final stats.
contracts.powerRestriction: Power constraints dormant without an owned usable power; grant no power and do not lower numeric mastery.
contracts.source: Actual committed owner identity and role only; no prey/army/companion/mentor/caption/future evidence.
contracts.context: Neutral condition/effect wording for health/vision; no disability or mental-health insult, body-shaming narration or real diagnosis.
contracts.funny: Only explicit funnyResult on actual spin supplies existing Shrek source-once hook; fixed grants/projections are not spins.
contracts.timing: Register once; numeric effects apply final-only and remain signed/unbounded. No new mastery/Enchant/Size spin.
contracts.extraWheels: None of these forty recipes automatically invokes severity, activation-chance or countermeasure wheel.
contracts.freeze: Freeze current eligibility, odds and recipes before external RNG; preserve old frozen draws.
contracts.atomic: Caller persists selected receipt and consumed request together, comparing current ownership fingerprint. Pure helper does not persist.

runtimeInterface.bodyCapabilities: Human sole physical ancestry auto profile; otherwise committed owner body-capability profile with matching identity fingerprint required.

openConfiguration: Non-Human body capability adapters and explicit race-specific None/affinities if desired.
Combat execution/effect magnitudes, duration, counters and body output adapters.
